name: Ulamog
description: Ulamog is one of the three Eldrazi titans, the smallest, a devourer of living and unliving matter whose name survives on Zendikar as the merfolk sea god Ula.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
timeline.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's tentacles rummage through a victim's soul and sting his memories one by one.
timeline.quote: Ulamog's tentacles, their touch like burning ice, rummaged through his soul

citation.text: Suffer the Past (Rise of the Eldrazi, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cultists in Akoum, infected by Ulamog's creative force, perform rituals that loosen the prison's bonds.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane releases the titans, and Kozilek's brood is said to retreat to remote corners of the world.
timeline.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kozilek emerges from deep underground after Ob Nixilis drains the hedron network imprisoning Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Kozilek emerged from deep underground nearby.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar and his students take part in the Liberation of Sea Gate and drive off Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: helped in driving off Ulamog 's brood

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi titans arrive on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: descended upon Zendikar, their monstrous forms dwarfing everything in their path.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers activate the hedron network at the Eye of Ugin, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cultists of Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison and broods devastate Zendikar.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twelve surviving cultists become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reinforces the prison on her own and leaves; the vampires are freed of Ulamog's yoke.
timeline.quote: After Nahiri enforced the Eldrazi prison all on her own, no more broods came to life.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: freed the Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood causes the Slaughter at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Its brood caused the Slaughter at Sea Gate

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's infection transforms twelve Zendikari cultists into the first vampire bloodchiefs.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire species

citation.text: "Vampire", section "The Bloodchiefs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akoum cultists infected by Ulamog's influence perform rituals that loosen the Eldrazi prison.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa, believing the titans should be freed to return to the stars, shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood attacks the Joraga and Nissa barely survives as their only survivor, saved by Hamadi's band.
timeline.quote: Nissa had barely survived, a band of humans saving her, apparently the only survivor of the Joraga tribe.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Worldwaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An enormous Eldrazi rises beyond the valley and the brood surges toward the camp.
timeline.quote: Then a figure, impossibly large, rose up behind the hills on the far side of the valley.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage the continent of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage

citation.text: Bane of Bala Ged (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The merfolk gods are revealed to be false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity

citation.text: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The last hedron slots into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.
timeline.quote: The last hedron slotted into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.

citation.text: Aligned Hedron Network (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon's army, joined by Kiora and Nissa, retakes Sea Gate and Ulamog is trapped with hedrons.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were driven from the city

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Jace then activated the hedron's magics and trapped Ulamog.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate is overtaken by the Eldrazi; Tazri meets Gideon Jura at a refugee camp.
timeline.quote: She first met Gideon Jura in a refugee camp outside the city, after a battle with Ulamog's spawn.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En warns that Ulamog is approaching Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was approaching Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog is trapped, but Ob Nixilis disrupts the network, freeing Ulamog and waking Kozilek.
timeline.quote: the demon planeswalker Ob Nixilis appeared and disrupted the network, leaving Ulamog to ravage the city and waking Kozilek as well.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul and Kozilek vanish six months after release, leaving Ulamog to ravage Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Six months after they had been released, both Emrakul and Kozilek vanished, only leaving a few spawn behind.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace dominates Jori En's mind to send her back to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.
timeline.quote: Jace dominated Jori En's mind to force her to leave him and return to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa and Kiora retakes Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora assaulted and retook Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon wrestles Ulamog while Nissa unearths hedrons and Jace triggers them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace then triggered them, activating their latent magic and knocking the titan off balance while trapping him.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Everything looked to be smooth sailing until Ob Nixilis arrived, knocked the hedrons out of alignment, and positioned himself between them.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kozilek arrives and rebuffs Gideon's army.
timeline.quote: they were rebuffed by the arrival of a second titan: Kozilek

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The death of Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
timeline.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
